name: Canvas drawing
responsibility: Walks a scene under its presentation and draws it on a Canvas, with the theme's palette, the glyph outlines and the CPU canvas on vello_cpu
description: It does what the SVG's stylesheet did: the colours of a theme, the recede of a lit set, the far view and the order in which a selected part is raised. A glyph is drawn from the outlines of the core's own faces. Vello on WebGPU and Vello GPU on WebGL2 implement the same Canvas trait in the browser crate.
